messages:
maya (PM): Morning all — starting a thread to map scouting opportunities for the next design-partner wave. Goal: recruit ~10 partners across 3 archetypes and lock a lightweight feedback/observability handoff. Thoughts on signals, referral incentives, and the feedback cadence? @andre @liz @simon
andre (Eng): Love it. Quick signals idea: >1000 tokens/day + 3 active sessions/day, sustained over 7 days. Also look for KV-cache heavy patterns and repeated long-context prompts — those are where our runtime recommendations matter most.
liz (Design): Proposed archetypes: (1) embed-search / low-latency apps, (2) gen-assist w/ tool-calls, (3) regulated internal workflows (on-prem/VPC). I'll sketch personas + example jobs-to-be-done.
simon (Solutions): Agree. We should ask for an anonymized workload snapshot (requests + sample prompts) and a short product use-case doc. Also need NDA + PII checklist up front.
maya (PM): Recruit incentives thought: $2k credit + priority onboarding slot + 2 hours concierge setup. Commitment: 3 feedback touchpoints over 6 weeks (short async surveys + one workshop). Is that low-friction enough? :thinking_face:
andre (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Observability handoff: require perf traces, one failing prompt example, and a tiny sample of tokens. Prefer a minimal JSON schema partners can paste: `{"workload_type":"chat|embed|batch","avg_qps":"number","p95_ms":"number","sample_prompts":"array"}` — keeps parsing simple.
liz (Design): Make feedback loops light: 15-min async survey after each milestone + one 45-min live workshop mid-run. For usability, capture a short video clip or screenshot of the partner flow.
maya (PM): @liz can you draft the invite copy + intake form? @simon can you draft the legal/PII checklist? Target: open outreach in 2 weeks if we have 6 confirmed pilots.
simon (Solutions): Will do. Also propose a one-page 'observability demo' template partners fill: screenshot + trace snippet + plaintext prompt list. That'll make Eval/Optimize suggestions actionable.
andre (Eng): Ops question: should we require dedicated capacity for any partners? Maybe offer routing options: `hosted (default) / dedicated (opt-in) / private (airgapped)`. We'll need to call out latency/cost tradeoffs in the intake form.
maya (PM): Success criteria draft: (a) >=80% partners complete >=2 feedback cycles, (b) at least 3 product changes attributable to partner feedback, (c) average time-to-onboard <=5 working days. Additions?
liz (Design): Add an exit NPS-style question + verbatim ask: "Would you recommend this beta? Why/why not?" Capture quotes for PR/validation.
recruit-bot: FYI forms.google.com/example has a 10-slot limit on the template — update if we plan to scale beyond that.
maya (PM): Next steps: @liz mock invite by EOD Friday, @andre emit perf schema + minimal data template by Monday, @simon produce legal/PII checklist by Monday. I'll assemble a 1-page scouting playbook and circulate for review. :raised_hands:
